title: Bulk client account data sent by external email
business_risk: Mass disclosure of client accounts; secrecy breach; GDPR/nLPD breach
detection_intent: CH/LU IBANs with client context sent outside the organisation

title: Client data uploaded to personal webmail
business_risk: Exfiltration through personal accounts outside monitoring
detection_intent: Restricted content uploaded to personal webmail domains

title: Client data copied to USB removable media
business_risk: Physical exfiltration; loss of unencrypted media
detection_intent: L3/L4 content or 5+ IBANs copied to non-approved removable storage
action: Block; override for approved device group only

title: Client or KYC data submitted to public generative AI
business_risk: Disclosure to third-party AI provider; loss of secrecy; cross-border transfer
detection_intent: Sensitive content pasted or uploaded to non-sanctioned GenAI services
justification_allowed: No for L4; Yes for L3

title: KYC files shared externally from SharePoint/OneDrive
business_risk: Anonymous or guest access to KYC dossiers
detection_intent: Restricted content shared with external users or anyone links

title: Card and payment data in Teams chats with external participants
detection_intent: PAN or payment order data in chat with external participants

title: Bulk printing of private banking portfolio statements
detection_intent: Portfolio documents with client IDs printed on non-approved printers
action: Block with justification; approved printer group allowed

title: Upload to unsanctioned cloud storage
business_risk: Shadow IT storage outside contractual control
detection_intent: Restricted content uploaded to non-sanctioned cloud domains

title: Exfiltration before an employee's departure
business_risk: Leaver takes client book or pricing models
detection_intent: Volume anomalies across USB; cloud; personal email for users in leaver scope
action: Alert and investigate; stricter endpoint policy for scope

title: AML suspicion information shared outside compliance (tipping-off)
detection_intent: Content combining AML suspicion vocabulary with client identifiers leaving the compliance perimeter
action: Strict block external; alert on internal outside compliance

title: Client data sent to a service provider outside approved channels
business_risk: Outsourcing without contractual and supervisory conditions
detection_intent: Restricted content to external domains not on the approved provider list
action: Block unless recipient domain in approved list

title: Cross-border disclosure of Swiss client identifying data
business_risk: Banking secrecy breach; unauthorised foreign access
detection_intent: CID sent or shared to recipients outside approved Swiss perimeter

title: Intra-group sharing of client data without need-to-know
business_risk: Professional secrecy breach towards group entities
detection_intent: Restricted content sent to group domains outside documented flows
action: Notify and justify; block for L4

title: Secrets and credentials in shared content
detection_intent: Credential patterns in messages; files or uploads to paste and code hosting sites

title: Investor register or pre-publication NAV sent externally
business_risk: Disclosure of investor identities; market-sensitive NAV data
detection_intent: Investor register (EDM) or NAV draft sent to non-approved external recipients
